{{Quote|A military and humanitarian crisis has erupted on the planet Cademimu. Governor Chornarov has declared independence from the Republic and stolen vital armaments that protect an entire star sector.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR:IntroCademimu" />}}
The '''Cademimu uprising''' was a conflict on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cademimu V]] that occurred during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] with the support of Cademimu's corrupt [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Chornarov]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Governor Chornarov was under investigation for corruption. He was about to be arrested by Republic officials when he declared his planet's independence.|Satele Shan|<ref name="TOR:IntroCademimu" />}}
[[File:Cademimu_V.png|thumb|left|250px|Cademimu V]]
When [[Cademimu V]] governor [[Chornarov]] faced charges of corruption he declared independence of the Republic. After the end of [[Separatist War|Ord Mantell civil war]], a portion of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian separatists]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ortol]] moved to Cademimu to serve as Chornarov's elite guard and help him size control of the planet and its missile defenses.

==The uprising==
{{Quote|As we speak, the governor is overriding Republic security protocols and arming the planetary missile batteries. His private army is quelling civilian riots, but the army's elite will protect the missile command center.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR:IntroCademimu" />}}
This action was not welcomed by the population of Cademimu which led to riots and civilian uprising. While Chornarov's private army was quelling the rebellion on the streets, General [[Ortol]] and his men fortified themselves in the missile defense command center.<ref name="Cademimu" />

The Republic sent a strike force to remove Chornarov and retake the missile system. At the same time, the Empire tried to exploit the situation and sent a strike force of its own. During the fighting, Ortol was killed inside the missile complex and Chornarov was eventually removed from power.<ref name="Cademimu" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cademimu uprising appears as the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' flashpoint Cademimu.<ref name="Cademimu" /> During the flashpoint the player has a choice to alter the trajectory of the missiles to target either the uninhabited moon (light side option) or enemy fleet in orbit (dark side option).
